summary: Regression validation after AuthContext/CartContext/CategoriesContext refactor (useMemo/useCallback + error logging). No behavioral regressions found. Backend: 25/25 tests pass (7 auth + 8 categories CRUD/RBAC + 11 slot/society + booking smoke). Frontend: mobile viewport (390x844) verified: categories render on Home (9 items), /auth/me works via session_token cookie, cart add/inc/dec via ServicePage works, cart persists across reload (uru_cart in localStorage, qty=2 -> reload -> qty=2), Admin Categories page - create/edit/delete of temp category all successful, delete of in-use category returns 400 with helpful message.
action_items: Optional (carry-over from iter3): legacy /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still has stale hard-coded expectations; can be deleted or updated. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext value memo includes derived scalars count/total in deps - harmless but redundant since they are already derived from cart; deps [cart, addItem, decItem, clearCart] would be sufficient.
AuthContext empty catch in checkAuth still swallows errors silently (setUser(null) is expected, but a console.debug on non-401 would help debugging).
CategoriesContext.catMeta returns a fallback with label=id (raw slug) when id not found - fine, but the icon prop when raw category has no icon still passes through resolveIcon; verified no NPE.
PUT /api/admin/categories does not validate slug/id change (label edit keeps same id) - good, avoids breaking references.
server.py still monolithic (~721 lines) - consider splitting into routers.
Refactor is clean; useMemo/useCallback correctly applied and no stale-closure risks observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: auth, categories, cart persist, category edit, category delete + in-use guard)

test_credentials: Uses pre-seeded sessions from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin=test_session_admin_001, customer=test_session_cust_001, provider=test_session_prov_001.
seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_Cat_<ts> categories created and deleted within the same test run. TmpUI_<xxx> category from UI test was deleted via the UI itself.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_categories_auth.py /app/backend/tests/test_slots_societies.py -v`. Frontend selectors used: category-item-<id>, edit-category-<id>, delete-category-<id>, category-name-input, icon-<Name>, color-<#hex>, create-category-button, update-category-button, add-item-<itemId>, inc-item-<id>, dec-item-<id>, qty-<id>. Cart localStorage key = 'uru_cart'. Session via cookie name 'session_token' or Authorization Bearer works for /auth/me.
rca of the issue: No issues found - refactor is behavior-preserving.
